Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.layer

Class UpdateLayerRequest

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.layer.UpdateLayerRequest
public class UpdateLayerRequest extends Object
Request DTO for updating a layer.

Builds the request body for PUT /rest/layers/{layerName} or PUT /rest/workspaces/{ws}/layers/{layerName}.

Supports partial updates — only set the fields you want to change.

Field notes

  • defaultStyleName: sets the default style. Pair with defaultStyleWorkspace when the style belongs to a specific workspace.
  • styleNames: sets additional styles. null leaves existing styles unchanged; an empty list clears them.
  • queryable: whether GetFeatureInfo is enabled (default true).
  • opaque: whether the layer is opaque (default false).
  • enabled and advertised: can be changed via PUT but are not returned in GET responses.
  • attribution: sending an attribution on PUT is reflected in subsequent GETs.
  • defaultWMSInterpolationMethod: one of Nearest, Bilinear, or Bicubic.
